guardMethod.inputs: Same frozen candidate Core+own Core instances and unchanged host/benchmark hashes checked before/after; harness hash and global compile-wrapper restoration checked. Exact per-import reads are not intercepted.
guardMethod.semantics: Original benchmark guards and preserved owner metadata; only generated CodeSection changes are admitted. Actual patched module lengths/hashes are separate from unchanged original owner accounting.
guardMethod.clock: Deferred to first post-run public guard access, outside benchmark timing; cumulative literal retirement is asserted except deliberately invalid omit keeps TSC0. Limited to two non-timestamp loops; no shipping future-bias claim.

metric: elapsedMs and internal execution timings only; wallMs is absent for these non-resume workloads.
ratioDirection: current/baseline by labels even in reverse. A/A uses two as-is candidate instances with the same labels.

reports.patchScope: Only generated run-function CodeSection/body lengths and instructions; original Core, host, imports, exports, locals, owner/source proofs and metadata byte accounting remain unchanged.
reports.comparisonScope: as-is versus selected generated-code variant in the same frozen Core/host; primary/reverse and independent as-is/as-is AA. Benchmark later cutoff sample>=4.
ceilings: omit is diagnostic only and deliberately violates the clock contract
future-bias is admitted only for the two fixed non-timestamp workloads; no shipping correctness claim
recorded resource/unit byte counts remain original owner metadata; compiled byte lengths are recorded separately
all setup and ordinary benchmark semantic guards remain unchanged; extra time-bank guard is deferred until the first post-run public guard access

oldCapture.scope: optional one-instruction cold generation after comparisons; its times are not recorded or compared
